thumbs.title: Why Operation Market Garden Was COMPLETELY Avoidable
thumbs.background: a saturated poster-style map of the Netherlands in 1944 (orange-yellow land, bright blue rivers, red Germany on the right), with the burning steel arch bridge of Arnhem drawn small in the centre under black smoke
thumbs.middle: a crumpled intelligence telegram floating in the centre with a red 'SS PANZER' stamp, and two grey German tank silhouettes hidden in trees near the bridge, circled by a thick glowing red ring

characters.name: General Walter Bedell Smith
characters.position: far left, large bust cropped by the left and bottom edges, facing right
characters.prop: a telegram with a red 'WARNING' stamp
characters.extra: Two big blue sweat drops on his bald head.

characters.name: Field Marshal Bernard Montgomery
characters.look: thin elderly British field marshal with a black beret with two badges, sharp nose, small pencil moustache, khaki battledress
characters.position: far right, large bust cropped by the right and bottom edges, facing left
characters.extra: Waving the warning away with a dismissive hand, chin up.

thumbs.light: warm orange glow from the burning bridge in the centre, rim light on both characters
thumbs.palette: orange fire and red Germany against blue rivers, khaki uniforms, one yellow accent in the headline

thumbs.title: Did Four Tanks REALLY Lose the Bridge at Arnhem?
thumbs.background: night over flat Dutch polder: a raised dyke road runs to the horizon, four British Sherman tanks stopped in a row on it, and far away on the horizon the steel arch bridge of Arnhem burns orange under black smoke

characters.name: a young British Guards tank commander
characters.look: young British tank commander in a black beret and khaki battledress, headset around the neck, standing in the turret hatch
characters.position: right 40% of the frame, big bust, head top about 15% from the top, turned toward the burning bridge on the left
characters.extra: One big blue sweat drop; a red question mark above his head.

symbols: a thick red dashed arrow along the dyke road from the tanks to the burning bridge, ending in a big question mark

labels.style: a white village name board with a red border

thumbs.light: dark blue night, strong orange firelight on the horizon and on the commander's face
thumbs.palette: deep night blue against fire orange, olive tanks, one yellow accent

thumbs.title: Arnhem in 2 Days? How Market Garden REALLY Fell Apart

panels.scene: bright sunny sky over heathland full of round white parachutes and landing gliders, perfect weather

characters.name: a British paratrooper
characters.look: young British paratrooper in a maroon beret and camouflage smock
characters.position: bottom centre of the panel, large bust

panels.scene: night, heavy rain over the dark river Rhine, small boats ferrying exhausted soldiers back across, a burning town behind

characters.name: the same British paratrooper
characters.look: the same young paratrooper, maroon beret soaked, mud on his face
characters.position: bottom centre of the panel, large bust
characters.extra: Rain streaming down; a single tear.

thumbs.light: left panel bright midday sun, right panel cold blue rain lit by orange fire
thumbs.palette: sky blue and white parachutes vs dark blue rain and orange fire, white divider
